title: Atrocious
summary: ATRO'CIOUS, adjective [Latin atrox, trux, fierce, cruel.] 1. Extremely hainous, criminal or cruel; enormous; outrageous; as atrocious guilt or offense. 2. Very grievous; violent; as atrocious distempe

inlines.v: ATRO'CIOUS, adjective [Latin atrox, trux, fierce, cruel.] 1. Extremely hainous, criminal or cruel; enormous; outrageous; as atrocious guilt or offense. 2. Very grievous; violent; as atrocious distempers.
